roles.title: Principal Cloud Solutions Architect
roles.description: Leads multi-cloud architectural strategy and enterprise landing zones.

roles.title: Enterprise Architecture Director
roles.description: Governs enterprise-wide technology standards, capability maps, and technology portfolios.

roles.title: Senior Data Architect
roles.description: Architects modern data warehouses, lakehouses, real-time streaming, and data mesh topologies.

roles.title: Senior Cybersecurity Architect
roles.description: Designs Zero Trust security architectures, IAM frameworks, and threat defense perimeters.

roles.title: Staff Software Engineering Lead
roles.description: Guides high-scale microservices, backend platforms, and engineering best practices.

roles.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
roles.description: Develops enterprise React frontends and asynchronous Python/Go microservices.

roles.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
roles.description: Builds robust web applications, REST/GraphQL APIs, and database migrations.

roles.title: Associate Software Engineer
roles.description: Implements core frontend features, unit tests, and bug fixes under guidance.

roles.title: Senior Backend Systems Engineer
roles.description: Specializes in distributed transaction processing, message queues, and high-throughput databases.

roles.title: Senior Frontend Platform Engineer
roles.description: Specializes in complex state management, design systems, Web Vitals, and UI performance.

roles.title: Senior DevOps / SRE Engineer
roles.description: Automates Kubernetes clusters, Terraform infrastructure as code, and CI/CD pipelines.

roles.title: DevOps & Cloud Automation Engineer
roles.description: Manages deployment pipelines, monitoring alerts, and containerization workflows.

roles.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
roles.description: Performs penetration testing, vulnerability remediation, and automated SAST/DAST audits.

roles.title: Senior SDET / QA Automation Engineer
roles.description: Authors end-to-end testing frameworks, API performance tests, and regression suites.

roles.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
roles.description: Architects predictive workforce forecasting models, LLM fine-tuning, and model governance.
